brief: Indian markets sold off broadly into the afternoon, with Sensex shedding about 1,430 points and Nifty slipping below 25,400 as metals and banks dragged, despite IT and auto stocks leading gains. Cyber incident reports at Suzlon and L&T Technology Services added caution, while US tech weakness and falling gold kept global sentiment fragile.
themes: IT and auto stocks lead gains
